displayName: Azure Machine Learning computes should not have public IP addresses
description: Audit AmlCompute clusters and compute instances where enableNodePublicIp is not false. A missing value is reported because the service default is a public IP.

builtInReview.gap: No live built-in audits enableNodePublicIp on Azure ML compute; B07 checks VNet placement only.

metadata.description: Audit reports compute with a public IP. Deny is available only for a separate explicit assignment.
